propositions: Project-criterion integration seam for code-review is incomplete: dynamic Pass-1 fan-in does not execute activated LLM-backed project prompts, eval/CLI resolution is plan-review-biased, and Pass-3 routing does not consistently consume repository-effective views.

Four-phase review contract must be enforced with strict boundaries: Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 assesses only, Pass 3 applies deterministic rules without LLM, and Pass 4 coaches without re-adjudicating.

The generic seam repair must map logical project.<name> ids to physical code-review-project-<name> ids without special-casing project.review-phase-boundaries and preserve overlay-absent repository behavior.
A balanced eval corpus with six positive cases (RP-F1..RP-F6) and six negative cases (RP-N1..RP-N6) must achieve 1.0 recall, 0.0 false-accept, 1.0 agreement across three runs, and Cohen kappa ≥0.70.
The pilot must remain advisory-only with block_threshold: 0.90 and blocking_enabled: false until separate reviewed ticket with accumulated Gerrit evidence supports promotion.
Live dogfooding on Gerrit must capture positive-control and negative-probe patchsets with Pass-2 and Pass-3 evidence, then remove the invalid directive before submission.
